questions.title: States that touch a Great Lake
questions.prompt: Name the US states with a shoreline on one of the five Great Lakes.
questions.disclaimer: Eight US states have a Great Lakes shoreline; the pool is exactly 8. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

questions.title: States with the most active volcanoes
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most active or potentially active volcanoes.
questions.disclaimer: Includes volcanoes classified by USGS as historically active or potentially active. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

source.name: Wikipedia — List of volcanoes in the United States

questions.title: States with the largest desert area
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the most land area classified as desert.
questions.disclaimer: Includes the Great Basin, Mojave, Sonoran, and Chihuahuan deserts. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

source.name: Wikipedia — List of deserts by area

questions.title: States with the largest wetlands area
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the greatest total wetland acreage.
questions.disclaimer: Includes all classes of wetlands per NWI: freshwater, estuarine, and marine. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

source.name: US Fish & Wildlife Service — National Wetlands Inventory

questions.title: States with the most known caves
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the greatest number of documented caves.
questions.disclaimer: Counts documented caves per NSS state surveys; includes both wild and show caves. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

source.name: National Speleological Society — State Cave Counts

questions.title: States with the longest surveyed cave systems
questions.prompt: Name the US states that contain the world's longest surveyed cave systems.
questions.disclaimer: Ranked by the longest single surveyed cave system located in each state. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

source.name: Wikipedia — List of longest caves in the United States

questions.title: States with the highest average elevation
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the highest average elevation above sea level.
questions.disclaimer: Mean elevation is measured across the entire state land area, so terrain distribution matters more than the highest peak alone. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: USGS — Elevations and Distances in the United States

questions.title: States with the most Mississippi watershed drainage
questions.prompt: Name the US states with the largest land area draining into the Mississippi River basin.
questions.disclaimer: Ranked by area of each state that drains to the Mississippi River (not total state area). DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

source.name: Wikipedia — Mississippi River (drainage basin section, sourced from USGS)

questions.title: Wettest States (Most Annual Precipitation)
questions.prompt: Rank the US states with the highest average annual precipitation (rain + melted snow), by statewide average.
questions.disclaimer: Statewide averages from NOAA 1991-2020 normals. Individual sites (e.g. Mount Waialeale) far exceed statewide means. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: NOAA NCEI — Climate at a Glance, Statewide Precipitation 1991-2020 normals

questions.title: Driest States (Least Annual Precipitation)
questions.prompt: Rank the US states with the lowest average annual precipitation, by statewide average.
questions.disclaimer: Rank 1 is the driest state (lowest inches per year). Statewide averages, not local extremes. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: NOAA NCEI — Climate at a Glance, Statewide Precipitation 1991-2020 normals

questions.title: Most Tornadoes Per Year
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by average number of tornadoes reported per year.
questions.disclaimer: Based on NWS annual counts for 1991-2020. Includes all confirmed tornadoes regardless of EF rating. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: NOAA NWS Storm Prediction Center — Annual Tornado Averages by State

questions.title: Most Hurricane Landfalls (1851-2020)
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by total number of hurricane landfalls in the historical record.
questions.disclaimer: Counts direct hurricane landfalls on each state's coast, per NOAA HURDAT2. A single storm crossing multiple states is counted once per state. DC not included (topic is state-scoped).

source.name: NOAA NHC — Continental U.S. Hurricane Impacts/Landfalls 1851-2020

questions.title: Highest Recorded Temperature
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by highest temperature ever officially recorded within their borders.
questions.disclaimer: Highest all-time official temperature per NOAA's State Climate Extremes Committee. Death Valley's 134°F (1913) remains debated but is the accepted official record. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: NOAA NCEI — State Climate Extremes Committee records

questions.title: Lowest Recorded Temperature
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by lowest temperature ever officially recorded within their borders (rank 1 = coldest).
questions.disclaimer: Rank 1 is the coldest ever recorded (most negative Fahrenheit). All-time official state minima per NOAA SCEC. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: NOAA NCEI — State Climate Extremes Committee records

questions.title: Most Sunshine Hours Per Year
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by average annual sunshine hours (statewide average).
questions.disclaimer: Statewide averages derived from NOAA/NWS first-order station normals. Some states are averaged across multiple reporting stations. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: NOAA / NWS Comparative Climatic Data — Mean Number of Hours of Sunshine

questions.title: Cloudiest States (Fewest Sunny Days)
questions.prompt: Rank the US states by cloudiest skies — states with the fewest average clear or sunny days per year (rank 1 = cloudiest).
questions.disclaimer: Rank 1 is the cloudiest state. Based on mean number of overcast days per NOAA/NWS station normals. Includes Washington DC.

source.name: NOAA / NWS Comparative Climatic Data — Mean Number of Clear Days
